title: Evaluating Rollout-Verified Reinforcement Fine-Tuning of a Reasoning Model for Multi-Zone Variable-Air-Volume Control
abstract: arXiv:2607.27914v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Heating, ventilation, and air-conditioning systems account for a large share of building energy use. High-performance control often requires building-specific modeling or training, limiting scalability. We investigate whether a frontier reasoning model -- a large language model trained to use additional inference-time computation -- can coordinate multi-zone variable-air-volume control without building-specific training, and whether rollout-verified reinforcement fine-tuning can improve a smaller, locally deployable model. Five controllers were evaluated over five summer days in a physics-based four-zone emulator. Across three runs, GPT-5 used 6.8-7.4% less electricity than a Guideline 36-based baseline, but used less outdoor air and had lower CO$_2$ compliance. translated_title: 评估面向多区域变风量控制的推理模型滚动验证强化微调
translated_abstract: 暖通空调（HVAC）系统占建筑能耗的很大比例。高性能控制通常需要针对特定建筑的建模或训练，这限制了可扩展性。我们研究一种前沿推理模型——即经过训练以利用额外推理时计算的大型语言模型——能否在无需针对特定建筑训练的情况下协调多区域变风量控制，以及滚动验证的强化微调能否改进更小的、可本地部署的模型。在基于物理的四区域仿真器中，对五个控制器进行了为期五个夏季日的评估。在三次运行中，GPT-5比基于Guideline 36的基线少用电6.8–7.4%，但其使用的新风更少，CO$_2$合规率也更低。GPT-5为微调较小的模型提供了能力参考。经过训练的强化学习控制器比基线少用电4.5%，同时改善了……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究表明，前沿推理模型GPT-5无需针对特定建筑训练即可协调多区域变风量控制并比Guideline 36基线节能6.8–7.4%（但新风量和CO₂合规率较低），而通过滚动验证的强化微调，更小的可本地部署强化学习控制器可在比基线节能4.5%的同时改善性能。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the frontier reasoning model GPT-5 can coordinate multi-zone variable-air-volume control without building-specific training, using 6.8–7.4% less electricity than a Guideline 36 baseline (though with less outdoor air and lower CO$_2$ compliance), and that rollout-verified reinforcement fine-tuning enables a smaller, locally deployable RL controller to use 4.5% less electricity than the baseline while improving performance.
